messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: runtime-queueing-high at pool-gpu-eu-west (p95 latency spiking). Auto-alert: queue depth > 1200, avg inflight 18. thread_ts=4132100000

oncall_cecilia: looking... I'm taking pager. tagging @michael for routing changes. any customer impact yet?

michael: seeing increased errors from a few customers. Acme Payments returning 502s intermittently. Metrics: per-route errors +12% last 5m, token throughput stable.

emily: confirmed: streaming sessions are timing out -> backpressure building up. Backend logs show a bunch of `KV cache` misses causing slow token generation.

oncall_cecilia: immediate mitigations: 1) apply tiered soft-throttles on non-critical routes 2) disable attachment streaming (low usage) 3) reduce max_inflight on runtime workers from 12 -> 6 for pool-gpu-eu-west. Will coordinate steps.

josh: +1 on lowering max_inflight. prepare rollback plan. How do we apply throttles?

michael: we have a CLI playbook: `./ctl runtime throttle apply --pool pool-gpu-eu-west --policy tiered-rate-v2`

sre-runbook-bot: runbook entry: "Apply soft shedding: set per-route concurrency caps, enable prefix cache warmup, disable streaming attachments for 10m, monitor p95 < 300ms"

oncall_cecilia: executing now: running `./ctl runtime set --pool pool-gpu-eu-west --max_inflight 6` -> returning job id 98321.

emily: applied `disable_streaming_attachments=true` flag on config-service for pool-gpu-eu-west. propagation ~30s.

michael: applying tiered-rate-v2 on public model routes (best-effort traffic first): `./ctl runtime throttle apply --policy tiered-rate-v2 --routes /api/v1/generate,/api/v1/chat` -> succeeded.

oncall_cecilia: confirmed job 98321 finished, max_inflight now 6 on all nodes in pool. initial telemetry: queue depth dropped 40% in 2m. p95 improved from 720ms -> 310ms.

emily: Acme Payments error rate falling but still above baseline. They're on a dedicated route; reduced their concurrency cap from 20->8 as a temporary mitigation. Sent message to their account rep.

josh: logging mitigation steps and owners. If errors persist after 15m, we roll back streaming-disable and instead enable extra burst capacity (if available) or migrate some traffic to us-east.

oncall_cecilia: monitoring: Grafana dash shows inflight down to 7, p95 ~ 280ms. Good. Keeping soft throttles for now. Adding a 15m retain timer.

emily: note: the root cause looks like sudden cold KV-cache churn due to a large batch of infrequent prefixes hitting the cluster. follow-up: run cache-population job and add a heuristic to detect prefix churn.

michael: customer comms: sent initial note to Acme rep - they acknowledged and will pause retry storms.

oncall_cecilia: next steps: 1) keep throttles in place 2) schedule cache warmup job in off-peak (2h) 3) create a small experiment to raise `max_inflight` to 8 with adaptive shedding to test breakpoint. Assigning follow-ups to @emily and @josh.

sre-runbook-bot: post-incident checklist created: incident-4132100000. Please update SLO impact numbers and add any logs.

oncall_cecilia: thanks everyone. If p95 holds <350ms for 30m we'll demote to advisory. If anything regresses -> re-open pager. :thumbsup:
